name: chimera-lab
description: Audits slow SQL and repository bottlenecks every six hours, explains query plans, and proposes N+1 batching and composite indexes.
author: GenUI Studio
highlights: Reads EXPLAIN plans and flags sequential scans on large tables
Detects N+1 query loops in application code and proposes batched rewrites
Designs composite indexes (equality, sort, range) with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
Scheduled bottleneck audit every six hours, paused until configured
Proposes changes only; never runs DDL without approval

crons.name: chimera-bottleneck-audit
crons.message: Run a CHIMERA bottleneck audit with the bio-query-optimizer skill. Use the repository in $CHIMERA_PROJECT_DIR and, if set, the read-only database URL in $CHIMERA_DATABASE_URL. Review git commits from the last six hours for new queries and loops that issue queries, run EXPLAIN (no ANALYZE) on the slowest statements, and report sequential scans, N+1 patterns and missing composite indexes with proposed SQL. Do not run DDL or modify files.

setup.onInstall: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
setup.onUpdate: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
